title: Cgm button not working anymore
body:
After updating dev-g to commit 1da267f the cgm button showed on main screen of aaps doesnt work anymore. In my case xdrip. Aaps tells there isnt an cgm app installed.

Aaps is still getting bg's from xdrip.
